answer.because: The measured miss is that stop_dollars and tp_dollars moved to either end changed no trade because the exit is placed only on the entry bar, locking the target and leaving the stop unrefreshed. Replace the entry-bar exit calls with a per-bar exit block while in position, keeping the stop at entry and the limit on close.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("ICT Unicorn + POC [Profit] Redesign 3", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(100, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)
use_trail         = input.bool(false, "Enable Trailing Stop")
trail_pct         = input.float(50, "Trail keep (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_step_amt    = input.int(500, "Trail: Tighten every ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
trail_step_pct    = input.float(50, "Trail step (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_min_dollars = input.int(1000, "Trail: Min Profit ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== INPUTS =====

profile_lookback  = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=500, step=10, group="Profile")
profile_rows      = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=50, step=5, group="Profile")
min_delta_pct     = input.float(5.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5, group="Profile", tooltip="0 = disabled")

vwma_len          = input.int(20, "VWMA Length", minval=1, maxval=200, group="Trend")
vwma_slope_len    = input.int(5, "VWMA Slope Lookback (bars)", minval=1, maxval=50, group="Trend")

pivot_len         = input.int(5, "Pivot Length", minval=2, maxval=20, group="Entry")
entry_end_hr      = input.int(11, "Entry End Hour", minval=10, maxval=14, group="Entry")
entry_end_mn      = input.int(0, "Entry End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, step=5, group="Entry")
max_entries_per_day = input.int(2, "Max Entries / Day", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Entry")


// ===== SESSION =====
sess_start_hr = 18
sess_start_mn = 0
sess_end_hr   = 16
sess_end_mn   = 0

sess_bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
sess_bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
sess_bar_t  = sess_bar_hr * 100 + sess_bar_mn
sess_clock_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
sess_clock_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

in_session = (sess_clock_start > sess_clock_end) ? (sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_start or sess_bar_t < sess_clock_end) : (sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_start and sess_bar_t < sess_clock_end)

// ===== TIME LOGIC =====
is_new_day = ta.change(time("D")) != 0
bar_time = sess_bar_hr * 100 + sess_bar_mn
in_entry_window = bar_time < (entry_end_hr * 100 + entry_end_mn)

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE + DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows
float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price    = na
float poc_hi       = na
float poc_lo       = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row      = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if array.size(arr) != rows
            array.clear(arr)
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.push(arr, 0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.set(arr, i, 0.0)
    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue
        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]
        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1
        if span <= 0
            continue
        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                array.set(vol_total, r, array.get(vol_total, r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    array.set(vol_up, r, array.get(vol_up, r) + per_row)
                else
                    array.set(vol_dn, r, array.get(vol_dn, r) + per_row)
    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = array.get(vol_total, r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r
    poc_price    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo       := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi       := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size
    float poc_up  = array.get(vol_up, poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = array.get(vol_dn, poc_row)
    float poc_tot = array.get(vol_total, poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== TREND & DELTA FILTERS =====
float vwma_val   = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
float vwma_slope = vwma_val - vwma_val[vwma_slope_len]
float ema_20     = ta.ema(close, 20)

bool trend_long  = (vwma_slope > 0) and (close > ema_20)
bool trend_short = (vwma_slope < 0) and (close < ema_20)

bool delta_long_ok  = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct >= min_delta_pct
bool delta_short_ok = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct <= -min_delta_pct

// ===== ENTRY LOGIC =====
var int day_entries = 0
if is_new_day
    day_entries := 0

bool entry_ok = barstate.isconfirmed and in_session and in_entry_window and day_entries < max_entries_per_day and strategy.position_size == 0

float pivot_low_val  = ta.pivotlow(low, pivot_len, pivot_len)
float pivot_high_val = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_len, pivot_len)

bool long_entry_sig = false
bool short_entry_sig = false

// Long Entry: Pullback into POC zone
if entry_ok and trend_long and delta_long_ok and not na(poc_lo) and not na(poc_hi)
    bool in_poc_zone = (close >= poc_lo) and (close <= poc_hi)
    if in_poc_zone and not na(pivot_low_val)
        bool pivot_in_zone = (pivot_low_val >= poc_lo) and (pivot_low_val <= poc_hi)
        if pivot_in_zone
            long_entry_sig := true

// Short Entry: Pullback into POC zone
if entry_ok and trend_short and delta_short_ok and not na(poc_lo) and not na(poc_hi)
    bool in_poc_zone = (close >= poc_lo) and (close <= poc_hi)
    if in_poc_zone and not na(pivot_high_val)
        bool pivot_in_zone = (pivot_high_val >= poc_lo) and (pivot_high_val <= poc_hi)
        if pivot_in_zone
            short_entry_sig := true

// Execute Entries
if long_entry_sig
    day_entries += 1
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

else if short_entry_sig
    day_entries += 1
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== SESSION CLOSE =====
if sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_end or (sess_clock_start > sess_clock_end and sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_start)
    if strategy.position_size != 0
        strategy.close_all(comment="Session End")

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", color.blue, linewidth=2)
plot(not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot(not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot(not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
bgcolor(in_session ? color.new(color.gray, 95) : color.new(color.red, 95))
plotshape(long_entry_sig, "Long Entry", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_entry_sig, "Short Entry", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)
